title: COMPASS: statistically verified refinement of probabilistic programs
description: COMPASS refines Bayesian models written as NumPyro programs. Language-model agents diagnose the model, search the statistical literature and propose candidate refinements, while a deterministic verifier with no language model in it fits the baseline and the candidate with MCMC and accepts a refinement only when a fixed statistical rule is met. The benchmark records behind the paper's figures are distributed as an asset of the GitHub release, not as part of this archive.
